symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two address chunks.
symbols.quote: Fast address-chunk interchange swaps two disjoint $u$-bit address fields of a bit array of volume $V$ (stored bits)

symbols.name: volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored bits of the array.
symbols.quote: Fast address-chunk interchange swaps two disjoint $u$-bit address fields of a bit array of volume $V$ (stored bits)

symbols.name: prefix
symbols.meaning: The address field before the first chunk.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$: prefix $p$, chunks $h,d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: first chunk
symbols.meaning: The address field of the first chunk.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$: prefix $p$, chunks $h,d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: second chunk
symbols.meaning: The address field of the second chunk.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$: prefix $p$, chunks $h,d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: gap
symbols.meaning: The address field between the chunks.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$: prefix $p$, chunks $h,d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: suffix
symbols.meaning: The address field after the second chunk.
symbols.quote: An address is $(p,h,g,d,z)$: prefix $p$, chunks $h,d$, gap $g$, suffix $z$; the goal is $(p,h,g,d,z)\mapsto(p,d,g,h,z)$.

symbols.name: radix
symbols.meaning: The fixed prime used as digit radix.
symbols.quote: Digits are radix $q$, a fixed prime.

symbols.meaning: The number of radix-q digits in each chunk.
symbols.quote: Let each chunk have $e=m^k$ digits.

symbols.name: level count
symbols.meaning: The number of levels, with e=m^k.
symbols.quote: Let each chunk have $e=m^k$ digits.

symbols.name: field digits
symbols.meaning: The number of digits in each of the m fields of a chunk.

symbols.name: vertex matrix
symbols.meaning: The rational m by m matrix assigned to a terminal or gate.
symbols.quote: each terminal and gate carries a rational $m\times m$ matrix $M$

symbols.name: edge index
symbols.meaning: Index of an edge of the network.
symbols.quote: and edge $i$ carries $A_i=M_{\mathrm{head}(i)}-M_{\mathrm{tail}(i)}$

symbols.name: edge matrix
symbols.meaning: The difference of the matrices at the head and tail of edge i.
symbols.quote: and edge $i$ carries $A_i=M_{\mathrm{head}(i)}-M_{\mathrm{tail}(i)}$

symbols.name: identity matrix
symbols.meaning: The m by m identity matrix.
symbols.quote: with $M_{\mathrm{out}(\rho(w))}-M_{\mathrm{in}(w)}=I_m$ (the identity)

symbols.name: wire index
symbols.meaning: The index of a wire of the network, 1 to W.
symbols.quote: The shear contract says input wire $w$ ends at output role $\rho(w)$

symbols.name: shear permutation
symbols.meaning: The array permutation moving the entry at address (H,D) to (H+MD,D).
symbols.quote: Let $\Phi_M$ move the entry at address $(H,D)$ to $(H+MD,D)$.

symbols.name: other vertex matrix
symbols.meaning: The matrix at the vertex at the far end of an edge.
symbols.quote: an edge to a vertex with matrix $M'$ changes it by $\Phi_{M'-M}=\Phi_{A_i}$

symbols.name: stream row
symbols.meaning: The row number within a role stream.
symbols.quote: send row $Wx+w-1$ to role stream $w$ as row $x$

symbols.name: input array
symbols.meaning: The physical input array on wire w.
symbols.quote: Wire $w$'s input $f_w$ is read as the logical array

symbols.name: output array
symbols.meaning: The physical output array at role rho(w).
symbols.quote: the output is $f'_{\rho(w)}=\Phi_{M_{\mathrm{out}(\rho(w))}}\Phi_{-M_{\mathrm{in}(w)}}f_w=\Phi_{I_m}f_w$

symbols.name: rest of h

symbols.meaning: The top nu digits of the second chunk.

symbols.name: rest of d
symbols.meaning: The remaining digits of the second chunk.

symbols.meaning: The range of the row field formed by the two high parts.
